_comment: pipeline config for agentic_rl_data.scripts.run_pipeline (plan §3 steps 1-8). Relative paths are resolved from the repo root. Optional steps (decontam/passrate) are skipped with an explicit reason when their inputs are not configured; they are never silently skipped.

build_raw._comment: sources empty => --all registered loaders; cfg_json points at {source: {path|hf_dataset|...}} (see configs/raw_sources.example.json); max_samples for smoke runs.

decontam._comment: bfcl_path: bfcl-eval data dir / gorilla BFCL dir / JSONL dump. null => step skipped ([NOT RUN] in data_report).

passrate._comment: needs a (task_id, pass_rate) file produced by the rollout side; disabled until plan §9 is wired.

report._comment: strict=false for iteration; set true (or pass --strict-report) for plan §8 acceptance.

export._comment: verl RLHFDataset parquet export (plan §9 -> verl). Needs pyarrow in the training env.
